# Job and data APIs for France, Germany, Spain and Latin America

> Seven REST APIs that return public job postings, freelance missions, films and crowdfunding projects as clean JSON. Sold on RapidAPI and Zyla API Hub, also available as Apify Actors.

## APIs

- [Free-Work Jobs API](https://morvanvivien.github.io/data-apis/free-work/): France IT jobs API: French tech jobs and freelance missions from Free-Work (free-work.com) as JSON, with daily rate (TJM), salary, skills, remote mode, location and full description.
- [German Jobs Arbeitsagentur](https://morvanvivien.github.io/data-apis/arbeitsagentur/): Germany jobs API: job postings (Stellenangebote) from the Bundesagentur für Arbeit Jobsuche (arbeitsagentur.de), Deutschland's largest job database, as JSON with salary, home office and location.
- [Spain Jobs Infoempleo](https://morvanvivien.github.io/data-apis/infoempleo/): Spain jobs API: Spanish job postings (ofertas de empleo) from Infoempleo (infoempleo.com) as JSON, with salary range, company, city, region, experience, contract type and description.
- [LatAm Jobs Bumeran Zonajobs Laborum](https://morvanvivien.github.io/data-apis/bumeran/): Latin America jobs API: postings (ofertas de empleo) from Bumeran, Zonajobs, Laborum, Multitrabajos and Konzerta for Argentina, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Panama and Venezuela, as JSON.
- [Codeur Freelance Projects France](https://morvanvivien.github.io/data-apis/codeur/): France freelance jobs API: freelance projects and missions from Codeur.com as JSON, with budget, offers, views, category, wanted profiles, date and the client's full brief.
- [AlloCine Movies France](https://morvanvivien.github.io/data-apis/allocine/): France movies API: films now playing in French cinemas, this week's releases and upcoming movies from AlloCine as JSON, with ratings, showtimes count, cast and synopsis.
- [KissKissBankBank Crowdfunding Projects](https://morvanvivien.github.io/data-apis/kisskiss/): Crowdfunding API for France and Europe: KissKissBankBank projects as JSON, with amount collected, goal, funding percentage, backers, category, city and dates.
